behavior: A tracked file with a conflict open or close marker line fails the guard with file:line, including a file Git treats as binary; the same marker untracked does not.
A Markdown setext underline of three or exactly seven '=' does not fail the guard.
The guard fails closed outside a Git work tree (under either safe.bareRepository branch) and reports the current tree clean.
Repository hygiene runs the guard and its fixture suite as unconditional run steps.
verification: awk '{sub(/\r$/, "")} /^    if:/{j=1} /^      - /{s=0} /^        if:/{s=1} /^        run: bash scripts\/check-conflict-markers.sh$/{g=!s} /^        run: bash scripts\/tests\/test-conflict-markers.sh$/{t=!s} END{exit !(g && t && !j)}' .github/workflows/repo-hygiene.yml

behavior: The suite fails when a required shell is missing, and CI installs zsh before running it under its default bash and zsh (the zsh half is CI-only: zsh is not required on a workstation).
verification: ! TCM_SHELLS='bash ci491-missing-shell' bash scripts/tests/test-conflict-markers.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && awk '{sub(/\r$/, "")} /apt-get install -y -qq zsh/{z=NR} /^        run: bash scripts\/tests\/test-conflict-markers.sh$/{r=NR} END{exit !(z && r && z < r)}' .github/workflows/repo-hygiene.yml
